pkgTitle: Continuing from an earlier solved version
title: FQ3: if continuation stalls, also try the existing restart?
body: In all five cases where the new policy rescued a failing edit, the existing policy (`T06-revision-v2`) also converged through its restart, in fewer iterations (5 against 10–12; 8 against 22–29). With one recovery per step, a stalled continuation ends the step without the restart, so the new policy can fail where the old one succeeds; this is declared.

options.label: One recovery per step, opt-in only
options.detail: Any rescue claim, or making it the default, first needs a case where the restart fails and continuation works.

options.label: Restart after a stalled continuation (two recoveries per step)
